Jean-Pierre Morel Appointed CEO of Groupe Électra as Industry Eyes Steady Growth

PARIS – Groupe Électra, a leading firm in France’s electrical equipment sector, announced today the appointment of Jean-Pierre Morel as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective July 1. Morel, 54, succeeds Anne Dubois, who retires after nearly a decade at the helm.

The company, headquartered in Lyon, manufactures and distributes a range of electrical components serving both domestic and international markets. Morel, previously Chief Operating Officer at Électra, brings over 25 years of experience in the industry, having started his career as an engineer and rising through various senior management positions.

“This is an exciting time for Groupe Électra and the wider electrical equipment industry in France,” said Morel in a statement. “I am honoured to lead such a talented team as we continue to innovate and meet the evolving needs of our customers, both in France and abroad.”

Industry analysts view Morel’s appointment as a sign of continuity for the sector, which has enjoyed stable growth over the past year. According to the French Association of Electrical Manufacturers (AFME), the domestic market expanded by 3.4% in 2023, driven by demand from renewable energy projects and modernisation of industrial facilities.

“Jean-Pierre Morel’s technical background and management expertise make him well-suited to guide Groupe Électra in a competitive landscape,” commented Sophie Lemaire, senior analyst at Marché Énergie Conseil. “His focus on sustainability and digitalisation aligns with industry trends.”

Local union representatives also welcomed the appointment. “We look forward to working constructively with Mr. Morel to maintain strong employment and training opportunities in the region,” said François Petit, spokesperson for the Rhône-Alpes Electrical Workers Union.

Groupe Électra employs over 1,500 people across France, with major operations in Lyon and Nantes.
